name: menu_collapse_remembered_library_copy
why: menu collapse on currently explicit information (plan step 4a part 2): B's Mishra's Bauble looks at A's top card, a Forest (CR 701.20e), and that look window closes as the ability finishes resolving; when A's Once Upon a Time then looks at the top five, both Forests are in A's window and in none of B's, so the dig menu offers one Forest row and #2 is the Island (B's memory of the look is its knowledge sidecar's, no longer the engine's Game::OppKnownLibraryTop, which kept the two Forests apart)
expect_order: ^Player B looks at top of Player A's library: Forest$
^Player A looks at the top 5 card\(s\) of their library\.$
^Player A reveals Island and puts it into hand\.$
expect_not: ^Player A reveals Forest and puts it into hand
